prompt: Build CurrencyPurse: it HAS a private list of the provided Cash records and answers balance questions about it, comparing currency codes case-insensitively.
explanation: The purse composes a List<Cash> rather than extending one, so its public API is exactly the five money operations and nothing else leaks out. Deposits are filtered on the way in, which keeps the invariant that every stored Cash is a positive amount. Formatting whole cents as units plus two digits is integer division and remainder, not floating-point arithmetic.
hints: Declare the list as a private field and create it where you declare it, so it is never null.
equalsIgnoreCase is the right comparison for currency codes; toUpperCase gives you the reported spelling.
1259 cents is 1259 / 100 units and 1259 % 100 cents -- String.format("%02d", ...) pads the remainder to two digits.
